recognize_zh: 這是自動尿液分析儀的報表而非顯微影像：試紙潛血 3+、蛋白 2+、白蛋白超過上限、顏色紅，但流式沉渣紅血球只有 31.8/µL，比例上不相稱，需想到低比重尿中紅血球溶解或血紅素尿，並配合沉渣影像找鐮刀形紅血球。
features: Dipstick chemistry: blood (hemoglobin) 3+, protein 2+, albumin over range, protein/creatinine and albumin/creatinine ratios 2+
Red urine color with specific gravity 1.008 and pH 6.0; bilirubin, ketones, glucose, nitrite and leukocyte esterase negative
Flow sediment (UF): RBC 31.8/uL (non-lysed RBC 11.7/uL), WBC 2.0/uL, renal tubular epithelial cells 3.1/uL, no casts
Bacteria count flagged high at 6363.6/uL despite negative nitrite and leukocyte esterase
Digital imaging (UD) class counts shown without images; myoglobin is not reported on this screen
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic automated urinalysis report combining dipstick chemistry, flow cytometric sediment and digital imaging class counts. The urine is red with 3+ blood and 2+ protein with albuminuria, while the flow-counted red cells (31.8/uL) are disproportionately low for the strength of the heme reaction. In dilute urine (specific gravity 1.008) this discrepancy may reflect red cell lysis or free hemoglobinuria, and myoglobinuria should be excluded separately (reported negative per the case). The high bacterial count without nitrite or leukocyte esterase positivity suggests contamination and should be correlated with culture. In a patient with sickle cell disease, the hematuria and proteinuria are compatible with sickle nephropathy.
